title: CrateNamingAudit
description: Audit of workspace.members against the 12-layer canonical enum (per ADR-0056). Captures each non-compliant crate with a proposed action: ADOPT the suffix as a canonical extension if it is a well-defined, multi-crate pattern, or RENAME to a canonical layer otherwise. Per user directive 2026-05-15: 'audit enums layers as well ... if they are well defined and serve a purpose, consider adopting them. otherwise stick to canonical layer types.'

_meta.purpose: Authoritative record of crate-naming compliance against ADR-0056. Each non-compliant entry is a tracked migration item; council-architecture ratifies adopt/rename verdicts on this file (per governance-amendment.json).

amended_by: ADR-0105 (2026-05-15): extends ADR-0056 12-value enum to 13 values; adds `api`; formalizes check-family + backend-suffix patterns. ADR-0565 (2026-06-21): removes `graphql` (13 -> 12); the owned stack carries NO GraphQL surface.

check_family.purpose: fitness-check µservice family: one crate per check, dual-purpose lib+bin. The µservice IS the layer (the crate's whole identity is 'a check named X'). Layer suffix is omitted by convention.
check_family.amendment_action: Add an exception clause to ADR-0056 §'12-Value Layer Enum' allowing `check-<feature>` as a self-layering convention; cite this spec.

backend_suffix.purpose: Backend qualifier on an adapter crate: the layer is `adapter`; the backend name is a sub-suffix denoting which external system. Already canonical (last canonical token is `adapter` and the backend qualifies it).
backend_suffix.binding: load-bearing — already implicit; document in ADR-0056 amendment as a recognized sub-suffix pattern.
backend_suffix.amendment_action: DONE per ADR-0105: ADR-0056 §'Layer semantics > adapter' amended with `{fake|aws|oci|inmemory|...}` as the allowed backend-qualifier set.

tools_implicit_app.purpose: ORIGINAL (rejected): Crates directly under tools/ are implicitly the `app` layer. REJECTED per user directive 2026-05-15 — no directory-implicit naming; every tools/ crate takes a canonical layer suffix from the 13-value enum (binaries use `-app`).
tools_implicit_app.binding: REJECTED — pattern removed; replaced by explicit canonical-suffix binding in ADR-0105 amendment 2026-05-15.
tools_implicit_app.amendment_action: REVERSED per ADR-0107 supersede 2026-05-15. Tools/ crates are renamed per their canonical layer suffix; binary tools take `-app`. Sole doctrinal carve-out: `tooling-agent-read` (ADR-0053 sanctioned primitive, NOT a layer-enum exception).

non_compliant.rationale: 21 crates consistently use `-api` as the contract-surface layer across cloud-*, identity, tenancy, ontology, policy-cedar, regional-pack, foundry-dashboard, foundry-adapter-anthropic-compat, foundry-adapter-openai-compat. Well-defined, multi-crate, purposeful: denotes 'this crate exposes a typed contract' without committing to HTTP-vs-gRPC-vs-GraphQL at the type level. Renaming all 21 to `rest`/`grpc`/`graphql` would lose the protocol-neutral contract framing.
non_compliant.amendment_action: DONE per ADR-0105: ADR-0056 §'12-Value Layer Enum' extended from 12 to 13 values; `api` added as a protocol-neutral contract-surface layer; depends-on-kernel-only flow rule documented.

non_compliant.rationale: ADR-0056 §'Concrete migration' (lines 283-289) explicitly slates `*-runtime` crates for rename to `*-app`. `runtime` is not in the canonical enum and doesn't generalize: each of the 3 crates is a composition-root binary that wires kernels + adapters into a deployable service — that is `app`'s exact definition.
non_compliant.amendment_action: Per-crate rename to `-app` suffix. Each rename = C1-shaped atomic commit (workspace.members + crate dir + Cargo.toml + all importers + any *-runtime binary refs in workflows/scripts).

crates.conflict_note: Already a crate named intelligence-account-app. Likely candidates: merge into the existing -app crate, OR rename to intelligence-account-runtime-app, OR rename to a more specific name like intelligence-account-supervisor-app. Council-architecture decision required.
Verify no name collision with ops-workspace-shell-application (which exists).

non_compliant.rationale: Each crate in `tools/` paired with a `crates/governance-<feature>-kernel`. Per ADR-0056 binaries are `*-app`. The tools/ binary should mirror the kernel name with `-app` suffix.
non_compliant.amendment_action: Per-crate rename to `*-app` suffix. Each rename touches: tools/<dir> rename, Cargo.toml workspace.members entry, internal Cargo.toml package name, any CI workflow `cargo run -p NAME` references, any scripts that invoke the binary by name.
non_compliant.alternative_rejected: Accept tools/ as an implicit-`app` layer convention. REJECTED per ADR-0107 amendment 2026-05-15 (no directory-implicit naming; every tools/ crate takes canonical layer suffix).
non_compliant.retirement_note: governance-archive-orphan retired by ADR-0118 instead of renamed; archive-orphan remains a historical lane id, not an active package name.

non_compliant.rationale: One-off non-canonical suffixes that don't generalize. Each crate's shape (lib-only vs bin vs both) determines the correct canonical mapping.

crates.note: PLURAL → SINGULAR. ADR-0056 §'Layer semantics > adapter' is singular.
Need to inspect — if lib, suffix `-domain` or `-application`; if bin, `-app`.
Tool binary; needs `-app` suffix per ADR-0056. Alternative: adopt tools/ convention (see ADOPT-PAT-03 candidate).
Sanctioned primitive per CLAUDE.md; renaming would break the agent operating contract. Adopt as fixed name (Exception). Add to ADR-0056 §'Naming exceptions'.

rejected_patterns: tools/-implicit-app (rejected per ADR-0107 amendment 2026-05-15 — replaced by explicit canonical-suffix binding)
amendment_proposal_summary.rename_estimate: 7 atomic commits, ~30-60 min per crate (C1-shaped: workspace.members + Cargo.toml + crate dir + all importers + verification build)

execution_dependencies: ADR-0056 amendment ratification (per governance-amendment.json §procedure) BEFORE any rename executes
Per-rename PR cites this audit row + the ADR amendment number
